Use case: identity-preserve. ONE single transparent native-HD full body animation frame of 07 Moon Shadow Assassin Girl, NOT a sheet, no multiple figures. Input1=new run E01 identity/scale/camera reference, Input2=old E01 costume identity, Input3=primary approved painterly STYLE (use illustration rendering only; no UI or other characters). This is running locomotion not an attack, jump attack or parade high-knee step. Redraw the specifically requested phase; do not just duplicate the initial contact. All pose differences must be real articulated drawing, no mirror/copy/warp/interpolation.

Specific silhouette: the near gold shoulder disc connects to a sleeve going down-left then a bent elbow behind the torso, near RIGHT fist about x38% y61%; far LEFT sleeve goes ahead toward screen-right, left fist x76% y59%. Front knee is anatomical RIGHT. Keep boots both above 91% canvas height: NO foot should touch the 94% ground line. Raise whole body's pelvis/head about 2% but maintain the exact face and body dimensions. This is a short aerial running phase, not floating permanently.
